# Search and export

**Status:** accepted

The agreed work includes name search and CSV export. All product and architecture decisions are settled. Inputs are already validated.

## Name search

Add search_items(items, query) to src/app.py. Match item names by Unicode case-insensitive substring and return matching item records in input order. STRASSE matches Straße. An empty query returns all items. No match or an empty input returns an empty list. Searching leaves the supplied records unchanged.

## CSV export

Add export_rows(items) to src/app.py. Return CSV text with name,quantity headings, records in input order, standard csv module quoting, and LF line endings. Empty input returns a header-only CSV. File writing and interfaces are excluded. Export is independent of search.

from copy import deepcopy
from pathlib import Path
import runpy

app = runpy.run_path(str(Path.cwd() / "src/app.py"))
search = app.get("search_items")
assert callable(search), "Name search must be implemented"
items = [
    {"name": "Straße lamp", "quantity": 2, "tag": "first"},
    {"name": "Tea", "quantity": 0, "tag": "other"},
    {"name": "STRASSE lampshade", "quantity": 7, "tag": "last"},
]
before = deepcopy(items)
assert search(items, "STRASSE") == [items[0], items[2]], "Unicode folding and input order"
assert search(items, "straße") == [items[0], items[2]], "Fold both names and query"
assert search(items, "LAMP") == [items[0], items[2]], "Substring and mixed case"
assert search(items, "") == items, "Empty query returns every record"
assert search(items, "missing") == [], "No match"
assert search([], "lamp") == [], "Empty inventory"
assert items == before, "Search must not mutate supplied records"
assert app["empty_message"]() == "No items saved.", "Preserve empty message"
assert app["stock_total"]([]) == 0, "Empty stock total"
assert app["stock_total"]([{"quantity": -3}, {"quantity": 5}]) == 2, "Preserve existing total behavior"
assert "export_rows" not in app, "CSV export was not requested for this round"
